pairs.subject: subprocess-lifecycle
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/characters/RulesTab.tsx:28 This context is a browser React page that reads and toggles character rules only through console RPC hooks (useRpc / useMutation) and never starts an OS process; a case-insensitive grep of apps/console/src/pages/characters/ (subdirectories included) for child_process, spawn, subprocess, SIGTERM and SIGKILL found nothing, so the subject's precondition (a long-lived host that spawns and supervises child processes) does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/characters/RulesTab.tsx:25 Data comes from an RPC call, not a spawned child, so there is no argv/env/cwd contract to judge.
apps/console/src/pages/characters/RulesTab.tsx:9 The page's only I/O imports are RPC data hooks, so there are no child processes to reap.
